_how_it_is_used: server_scripts/grindless/zpm/fusion.js (addMk5Converter) makes one gtceu:direct_conversion recipe per entry of 'converter.recipes' (id grindless:<name>), 1 mB in, 1 mB out, 2 ticks, at -eut EU/t. The converter runs 128 parallels, so a row's EU/t is 128 x the row's: 67,108,864 (he3he3), 50,331,648 (pli6) and 100,663,296 (pn15) EU/t. The rows are final: power/generators.js lists the plasma generator, not gtceu:direct_conversion, so the x2 is never applied to them.
